about: Common FRED series by id: what each measures, its unit and how its values combine over time (rate: averaged and changed in points; index and level: averaged; flow: added up). Read by nl_browser._series_names when no AI plan names a column. Prefixes name a family of series.

CORESTICKM159SFRBATL: The 12-month % change in the Atlanta Fed's sticky-price consumer price index less food and energy, monthly
STICKCPIM159SFRBATL: The 12-month % change in the Atlanta Fed's sticky-price consumer price index, monthly
FLEXCPIM679SFRBATL: The 12-month % change in the Atlanta Fed's flexible-price consumer price index, monthly
CPIAUCSL: Consumer price index for all urban consumers, all items, seasonally adjusted (BLS)
CPILFESL: Consumer price index less food and energy, all urban consumers, seasonally adjusted (BLS)
CPIUFDSL: Consumer price index for food, all urban consumers (BLS)
CPIENGSL: Consumer price index for energy, all urban consumers (BLS)
PCEPI: Personal consumption expenditures chain-type price index (BEA)
PCEPILFE: PCE price index excluding food and energy (BEA)
PPIACO: US producer price index: all commodities (1982 = 100)
Producer price index for all commodities (BLS)
UNRATE: The share of the labour force without a job and looking for one, seasonally adjusted (BLS)
CIVPART: The share of the population 16 and over in the labour force (BLS)
PAYEMS: All employees on nonfarm payrolls, seasonally adjusted (BLS)
ICSA: New claims for unemployment insurance each week, seasonally adjusted (Department of Labor)
FEDFUNDS: The effective federal funds rate, the Federal Reserve's policy rate, monthly average
DFF: The effective federal funds rate, daily (Federal Reserve)
DGS10: Market yield on 10-year US Treasury securities, constant maturity (Federal Reserve)
DGS2: Market yield on 2-year US Treasury securities, constant maturity (Federal Reserve)
T10Y2Y: The 10-year Treasury yield less the 2-year yield, in percentage points (Federal Reserve)
T10YIE: Inflation expected over 10 years, from Treasury and inflation-protected yields (Federal Reserve)
MORTGAGE30US: Average 30-year fixed mortgage rate, weekly (Freddie Mac)
PSAVERT: Personal saving as a share of disposable personal income (BEA)
GDP: US gross domestic product ($ billions, annual rate)
Nominal GDP, seasonally adjusted annual rate, quarterly (BEA)
GDPC1: US real GDP (2017 $ billions, annual rate)
Real gross domestic product in chained 2017 dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate (BEA)
INDPRO: Output of manufacturing, mining and utilities (Federal Reserve)
HOUST: New privately owned housing units started, seasonally adjusted annual rate (Census Bureau)
RSAFS: US retail and food services sales ($ millions)
Advance retail sales: retail trade and food services, monthly (Census Bureau)
RSXFS: US retail sales excluding food services ($ millions)
Advance retail sales: retail trade, monthly (Census Bureau)
M2SL: M2 money stock, seasonally adjusted (Federal Reserve)
UMCSENT: University of Michigan index of consumer sentiment
DCOILWTICO: WTI crude oil price ($ a barrel)
West Texas Intermediate crude oil spot price, Cushing, Oklahoma (EIA)
DCOILBRENTEU: Brent crude oil price ($ a barrel)
Brent crude oil spot price, Europe (EIA)
DEXCAUS: The US dollar to Canadian dollar exchange rate, daily (Federal Reserve)
DEXUSEU: The US dollar to euro exchange rate, daily (Federal Reserve)
CSUSHPINSA: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller US national home price index
GFDGDPA188S: US gross federal debt as a share of GDP (%)
Gross federal debt as a percent of gross domestic product, annual (US Office of Management and Budget)
GFDEGDQ188S: US total public debt as a share of GDP (%)
Federal debt: total public debt as a percent of gross domestic product, quarterly, seasonally adjusted
FYFSGDA188S: US federal surplus or deficit as a share of GDP (%)
Federal surplus or deficit (a deficit is negative) as a percent of gross domestic product, annual
GFDEBTN: US federal debt: total public debt (millions of dollars)
Federal debt: total public debt, quarterly, in millions of dollars (US Treasury)

PCU: US producer price index for an industry
A producer price index for one industry (BLS, by NAICS code); its base month = 100
WPU: US producer price index for a commodity
A producer price index for one commodity group (BLS); its base period = 100
CUUR: A consumer price index series, not seasonally adjusted (BLS)
CUSR: A consumer price index series, seasonally adjusted (BLS)
